title: Compare the mastery cheat across three candidate records
changes: Document a bounded CH-0320 comparison of the first three candidate character records and the two written bytes beyond the previously inspected progress span.
validation: A protected same-seed EUR/Wine interpreter pair matched complete pre-application state, frame, clock and all three 264-byte candidate records. One armed frame recorded 72 halfword writes; all first-record bytes 40..CF differed versus the no-cheat control, while the remaining first-record bytes and the second and third records matched. The result persisted at a matching frame and clock 60 frames after disarm; immediate captured map images matched. Inputs remained protected and Wine drained (dbg22-mastery-three-records-fiwjrgz3).
A prior execution was refused before launching the guest because the shared Wine lease was held (brha_wrb).
limitations: Offsets CE..CF are outside the earlier 142-byte candidate span; their meaning and possible later effects are unknown. Three records and one map scene do not establish all unit, ability, gameplay, native Windows or original device behavior.
